qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the oil drain plug?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil drain plug has two torque specifications: M12 x 1.5 at 25 Nm and M22 x 1.5 at 60 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What are the torque values for mounting the oil pan to the engine block?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil pan on engine block has two torque specifications: M6 8.8 at 10 Nm and M6 10.9 at 12 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What component is referenced as 1AZ in the oil pan section?
qa_pairs.answer: 1AZ refers to the oil drain plug.

qa_pairs.question: What component is referenced as 2AZ in the oil pan section?
qa_pairs.answer: 2AZ refers to the oil pan on engine block.

qa_pairs.question: What section number covers the engine oil pan specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 11 13 covers the oil pan specifications.

qa_pairs.question: What is the unit of measurement used for all torque specifications on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: All torque specifications are measured in Nm (Newton meters).

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for the higher torque oil drain plug specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The M22 x 1.5 screw size is used for the 60 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for the lower torque oil drain plug specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The M12 x 1.5 screw size is used for the 25 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: What type designation applies to all the components listed in this oil pan section?
qa_pairs.answer: All components in this section are designated as type 'All'.

qa_pairs.question: What is the document reference number shown at the top of this page?
qa_pairs.answer: The document reference number is AZD11-10.frb dated 20/10/97.
